review: 702.181a-2: empty_graveyard expected left the trigger's firing implicit; Mobilize X still triggers with X = 0, now stated.

scenarios.title: Mobilize creates attacking tokens that are sacrificed at the end step
decisions: A attacks player B with Shock Brigade.
Both players pass; the mobilize trigger resolves.
Both players pass through combat damage and on to the end step; the sacrifice trigger resolves.

variants.label: attacks
variants.expected: The mobilize trigger fires and creates one 1/1 red Warrior token, tapped and attacking B. Combat damage is 2 in total (Shock Brigade 1, Warrior 1): B's life is 18. At the beginning of the end step the Warrior token is sacrificed and A controls only Shock Brigade.

variants.label: no_attack
variants.expected: The mobilize trigger does not fire and no token is created. B's life stays 20.

scenarios.title: Mobilize N creates N tokens

setup.notes: Avenger of the Fallen has Mobilize X, where X is the number of creature cards in A's graveyard.

decisions: A attacks player B with Avenger of the Fallen.
Both players pass; the mobilize trigger resolves.
Both players pass through combat damage and on to the end step; the sacrifice trigger resolves.

variants.label: two_creature_cards
variants.expected: Two 1/1 red Warrior tokens are created, tapped and attacking B. Combat damage is 4 in total (Avenger 2, Warriors 1 + 1): B's life is 16. At the beginning of the end step both tokens are sacrificed.

variants.label: empty_graveyard
variants.delta: A's graveyard is empty instead of holding two creature cards.
variants.expected: The mobilize trigger fires and resolves with X = 0: no Warrior tokens are created. Avenger of the Fallen deals 2 combat damage: B's life is 18.
